entries.name: Votive Thresher

counterPressure.note: Everything it does routes through the strike itself. Nothing here helps the wielder who is not swinging it.

entries.flavor: It parts what it strikes the way a vigil parts the dark - gently, and without hurry.

entries.name: Trunk of the Vigil

counterPressure.note: The roots only reach as far as the ground the wearer is actually standing on.

entries.flavor: Roots that have held their ground since before the fence line went up do not let go for a little noise.
entries.notes: BREAKS A GENERATOR RULE ON PURPOSE, same class of break as the shipped exemplar (unique.ember-harvest-30-001). atom.entangling (status.apply, the control family group) lists roles armament-primary/armament-secondary/manipulator/jewel-major/jewel-minor-a/jewel-minor-b/sense in g-on-hit.json - core-guard is not among them, and no legal core-guard family is a crowd-control verb at all (its legal pool is vitality/fortitude/mending/cleansing/warded/evasion/elemental-defense - all raw stats or shields, never a status.apply). A unique's fixedAtoms sit in the container's fixed core, never drawn from the role-filtered pool, so the role x family legality matrix (a DERIVED check over pool_rolls) never sees this atom. This is the one row on the assigned table (core-guard / control) where the axis cannot be expressed by any legal family at all, which is exactly the situation a unique class exists to cover. atom.stalwart and atom.fortitude are both legal for core-guard and carry no such note.

entries.name: Wardenbough

counterPressure.note: It clears what is already on the wearer. It does nothing for a status the wearer has not yet caught.

entries.flavor: Nothing crosses the fence line unlooked-at while this branch still holds its leaves.
entries.notes: BREAKS A GENERATOR RULE ON PURPOSE. ward-array's entire legal pool, corpus-wide, is the five shield-stat families (shield-capacity/toughness/regen, shld-surge/cycle) - no other family in affix-families/ lists ward-array as a legal role, which means the role's pool can only ever roll raw shield numbers and can never express a utility verb (a cleanse) no matter how it is rolled. atom.cleansing (status.clear) is legal for head-guard/core-guard/mantle/footing/girdle/jewel-major/jewel-minor/armament-secondary but not ward-array. Fixed atoms are outside the drawn pool, so the break costs the architecture nothing. atom.shield-toughness and the shield-capacity varianceSlot are both native to ward-array's own family group and carry no such note.

entries.name: Lampfruit

counterPressure.note: The orchard does not give without also taking; carrying this thorn costs the wearer the way econ-toll's own toll does, quietly and every round.

entries.flavor: It ripens without a season, and gives without being picked.
entries.notes: BREAKS A GENERATOR RULE ON PURPOSE. atom.sunbloom (resource.economy) lists roles girdle/jewel-major/jewel-minor-a/jewel-minor-b in g-economy.json - armament-secondary is not among them, and no legal armament-secondary family touches the economy channel at all (its legal pool is status.apply/atk-stat/elemental-power/shield-stat/tempo, none of them resource.economy). This is the assigned table's other axis with no legal-pool path: armament-secondary / economy. atom.might and the shield-toughness varianceSlot are both legal for armament-secondary and carry no such note.

entries.name: Haloed Corolla

counterPressure.note: A pure damage stack with no rider - the whole build is the swing, not the surprise.

entries.flavor: Even closed, it does not go dark.

entries.name: Frond of the Threshold

counterPressure.note: The leaves close only over a wound that is actually open.

entries.flavor: It closes only over what still needs closing.

entries.name: Cloistered Bough

counterPressure.note: A canopy this heavy costs the wearer the tempo atom.quickening would otherwise give back.

entries.flavor: Whatever it shelters, it also keeps.
entries.notes: BREAKS A GENERATOR RULE ON PURPOSE. atom.withering (status.apply) lists roles armament-primary/armament-secondary/manipulator/jewel-major/jewel-minor-a/jewel-minor-b/sense in g-on-hit.json - mantle is not among them, and mantle's own legal pool (vitality/fortitude/mending/cleansing/warded/evasion/elemental-defense/stoicism) has no status.apply family at all, the same gap core-guard has for the same reason: neither slot's pool carries a control verb. atom.evasion and the stoicism varianceSlot are both legal for mantle and carry no such note.

entries.name: Candlebranch

counterPressure.note: Both riders are upkeep, not damage; a build that wants pure offense from its crown slot gets nothing here.

entries.flavor: A crown that keeps its own small light lit, so nothing tended beneath it has to grow in the dark.
